chunks: And a crowd of the later ones.

key_terms.وَثُلَّةٌ: a crowd or a large group

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'later ones' mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase often denotes the 'Thultha' (a third) of the community, representing the faithful who remain steadfast amidst the majority who may deviate or the minority who are strictly righteous. It underscores the concept of the 'Baqiya' (the surviving righteous) who preserve the true essence of Islam through the ages, particularly highlighted in the context of the Ahl al-Bayt's endurance. This continuity emphasizes that true guidance is not limited to the initial generation but persists through a dedicated remnant until the end of time.
